description: This PHP file defines the 'Category' controller class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It handles displaying product category pages, including retrieving category info, constructing breadcrumbs, listing subcategories and products, applying sorting and pagination, and rendering the category view.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Controller class managing product category pages, including loading category info, handling request parameters for sorting and pagination, building breadcrumbs, listing subcategories and products, and rendering the category view.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to handle displaying a product category page. It processes request parameters, fetches category and product data, sets up page metadata, build breadcrumbs, handles sorting, pagination, and finally renders the category view template.
